scope: Exactly the 36 unique reward-category weapon IDs derived from major_rewards.json and expanded_rewards.json
method: Exact installed JAR bytecode/resources, shipped config, Java animation builders and read-only server load evidence; no gameplay execution or balance mutation

p1nero_ec.role: active Cataclysm Epic Fight Java presets, skills and mixins

shared_boundaries.ordinary_damage: Values are a full-charge vanilla player attack before target mitigation: player base 1 plus the exact main-hand attack-damage addition. Bow-only utility items therefore show 1 melee damage separately from projectile damage.
shared_boundaries.combo: A capability type or Java combo list does not prove per-phase damage, recovery or stamina. Numeric combo totals remain blocked unless the effective resource and every active animation phase are both resolved.
shared_boundaries.progression: JEM Progression is conditional on the enchantment being present. Tier I x1.00, Tier II x1.05, Tier III-V x1.10; Tier III-V additionally has a source-backed 15% x1.5 critical branch. It is not applied universally.
shared_boundaries.durability: Unbreakable means the exact installed implementation has no max damage or overrides damageability/setDamage so wear cannot accumulate; it is not inferred merely from a missing local hurtAndBreak call.
shared_boundaries.dps: Special-only sustained totals use one activation at t=0 and then the exact cooldown. They are not whole-weapon DPS and do not assume simultaneous ordinary attacks, infinite stamina or unverified repeated collisions.
